spec_match.rationale: Instruments the exact contract the change modifies — when light dismiss fires relative to pointerdown/pointerup/click — for both popovers and closedby=any dialogs, with verdict rules matching measured engine behavior: held-press never closes, completed clicks close in both models, and a no-click dismissal is the pair-model signature.

interactive.rationale: Live popover + dialog stages; every trusted input phase and dismissal lands in the timeline log; the verdict recomputes per dismissal with millisecond deltas.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb (updated alongside the fix) promises the timeline instrument and the myth-bust, not a false hold-discriminator; matches.

edge_cases.rationale: Esc dismissals filtered as non-diagnostic; gestures with no recorded pointer flagged; the UNEXPECTED mid-press branch exists so an engine that really closed on press would be reported rather than misclassified. The page's first draft claimed legacy closes at pointerdown — trusted-input measurement disproved that (legacy closes at release) and the page was corrected to teach the measured truth.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6209615938322432, the spec PR, and the pointerevents discussion.

conformance.rationale: The suite's toggle-event and untrusted-immunity assertions are this instrument's foundations (trusted-gesture behavior itself can't live in a script assertion, and the suite says nothing false about it).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP Input (trusted events): held press outside → popover stayed open (myth-busted); release → dismissal with timeline 'down +0 → up → click +1ms → closed'; right-button press-release → dismissal with '(no click)' correctly flagged as the pair-model signature (timeline: up +158ms, closed +160ms). LightDismissFromClick on this 141 build measured as silently ignored — recorded on the page. Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: legacy/modern verdict colors rose/emerald on stone (AA); stages on paper; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Verdict role=status aria-live; timeline role=log with labelling heading; native buttons; dialog uses closedby with the unsupported case disabling the leg with an explanation.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Stages and logs single-column; popover max-width respects small viewports; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Capture the click-model timeline on Chrome 145+ with the flag
openQuestions.detail: On a 145+ build with LightDismissFromClick, the right-click and drag gestures should leave the popover open (no verdict fires) — capture that run to pair with the legacy evidence recorded here.

guidanceConsulted.query: popover light dismiss outside click touch scroll gesture
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rely on native popover/dialog dismissal semantics; observe via toggle/close events.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Instrument observes only toggle/close events; the dismissal machinery is entirely native.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use declarative popovertarget/closedby wiring over custom scripting.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Popover opens via popovertarget; dialog uses closedby=any (show() deferred one tick so the opening click isn't misread).

summary: Verified headlessly with trusted CDP input (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the instrument's own first-draft premise (legacy closes at press) was disproved by measurement, the page was rewritten to teach the measured truth, and all three verdict branches were exercised for real — hold-survives, completed-click timeline, and the no-click legacy signature.
